I haven't recorded the 382-seat figure. Our records show 40 seats for Marrow Agrisupply, so I asked Tobias in a thread reply in #central-team where 382 comes from.

Here's what's on file:
- The Affiliate Amendment, effective 2025-10-15, sets Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats on support tier 1.
- The 2026 renewal order form, signed 22 Apr 2026, says it doesn't change Marrow Agrisupply's seat count. That count stays as the Amendment set it.
- The account page, last updated 15 Sep 2026, still says 40 seats.

I asked him whether 382 comes from a newer amendment or order form, or whether he meant a different number. Once he names the source, I'll update the records.

Seat counts aren't finance figures, so it was fine to mention them in the channel. I left the per-seat pricing out.
